subsystems.name: Discrete substrate
subsystems.role: the fundamental state and its update rule — the 'machine code' the universe would run on.

subsystems.name: Quantum-information layer
subsystems.role: encodes states as information and amplitudes, so that quantum behaviour can emerge.

subsystems.name: Emergence and coarse-graining
subsystems.role: extracts continuous spacetime, fields and particles from the discrete rules at large scales.

subsystems.name: Observable pipeline
subsystems.role: turns raw simulation output into quantities that can be compared with measurements.

subsystems.name: Compute infrastructure
subsystems.role: the hardware needed to evolve candidate rules of any useful size.

buildSteps.title: Pick a substrate and rule
buildSteps.detail: Choose a discrete update scheme — a cellular automaton, a rewriting system on hypergraphs, or a quantum circuit — whose local rules already contain the symmetries you want. No rule is known that reproduces observed physics.

buildSteps.title: Build an efficient engine
buildSteps.detail: Write code that evolves the state over billions of cells or nodes, exploiting locality so the work can be spread across large parallel machines.

buildSteps.title: Recover special relativity
buildSteps.detail: Check that information propagates at a finite speed and that light cones emerge, giving Lorentz-like behaviour without being put in by hand.

buildSteps.title: Recover quantum mechanics
buildSteps.detail: Show that interference, superposition and entanglement statistics fall out of the underlying informational rules rather than being assumed.

buildSteps.title: Recover gravity
buildSteps.detail: Demonstrate that a smooth curved geometry — and something like general relativity — appears in the coarse-grained limit. Holographic models have done this only for a special curved spacetime, not ours.

buildSteps.title: Recover the particle physics
buildSteps.detail: Attempt to obtain the known fields, charges and interaction symmetries as the low-energy description of the discrete model.

buildSteps.title: Calibrate the constants
buildSteps.detail: Tune the rule's parameters so the simulated masses and coupling strengths match measured values. No mapping from rules to real constants exists today.

buildSteps.title: Find a distinguishing prediction
buildSteps.detail: Identify an effect where the discrete model differs measurably from standard physics, then look for it in precision experiments — otherwise the framework is a reformulation, not a testable technology.

prerequisites.tech: Quantum information theory and tensor networks
prerequisites.why: supplies the working language connecting information, entanglement and physical states.

prerequisites.tech: Holographic duality (a quantum theory on a boundary producing gravity in the interior)
prerequisites.why: real toy models exist, but they describe a special curved spacetime rather than the expanding universe we live in.
candidate rules and quantum systems grow exponentially in cost with size, so only small cases can be evolved.

prerequisites.tech: A tested theory of quantum gravity
prerequisites.why: without one there is no benchmark telling you whether an emergent model got the right answer.

prerequisites.tech: A measurable deviation from standard physics
prerequisites.why: with no predicted observable difference, the framework cannot be confirmed or refuted as a technology.

pathway.milestone: toy models in which spacetime geometry emerges from entanglement in a boundary quantum system
pathway.unlocks: confidence that emergence from information is mathematically possible at all.

pathway.milestone: discrete models reproducing both quantum mechanics and gravity in the same limit
pathway.unlocks: a candidate unified description worth simulating at larger scale.

pathway.milestone: a prediction that differs from standard physics and is testable in the lab
pathway.unlocks: a genuine experimental target rather than a philosophical interpretation.

pathway.milestone: if confirmed, an underlying rule set used to compute physics directly
pathway.unlocks: simulation of materials, nuclei and extreme conditions from first principles — or the conclusion that this was metaphysics, not an engineering path.
